reason: An HTTP API gateway plugin that lets third-party clients authenticate to a running Harness, create or adopt agent sessions, exchange messages, stream responses, and access session history.

summaries.zh: 通过 REST 和 SSE 接口让第三方客户端认证并操作运行中的 Harness 智能体会话。
summaries.en: Exposes a REST and SSE interface for authenticated third-party clients to operate agent sessions in a running Harness.

capabilities: Exposes the running Harness through REST and SSE endpoints
Creates sessions and sends messages to agent sessions
Streams agent responses and reads session histories
Discovers and adopts existing GUI sessions
Provides API-key and admin-key controls for runtime enablement and key rotation
